## Checklist

Merging to `main` publishes to NuGet (see [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/andrewBezerra/xunit-assured-net/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#pull-requests)).

- [ ] `<Version>` raised in `src/Directory.Build.props`
- [ ] `docs/releases/<version>.md` written
- [ ] Entry added to the top of `CHANGELOG.md`
- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] Builds with no new warnings
